answer: History-backed bid escrow ties bidding to append-only task history: each new identity must pass a liveness pulse and post the maximum escrow before its first bid. A unique ferrous hardware tag signs enrollment, so copying a software key does not clone the tag. The ledger arranges signed task links on a trellis, and escrow returns only after completed work, so an attacker pays one full escrow plus tag attestation per clone while an honest agent reuses one history.
